claims.text: Henry Moore Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers.
Henry Moore Grants fund research that expands the appreciation of sculpture.

Categories covered by the grants include exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, and development of collections through acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display.
Applications are considered four times per year.
The Autumn round of applications is currently open.
The Autumn round of applications closes on September 1st at 23:00 GMT.
Projects funded in the Autumn round must start or open to the public no sooner than January 1st, 2027.
The Winter round of applications opens on November 1st at 9:00 GMT.
The Winter round of applications closes on December 1st at 23:00 GMT.
Projects funded in the Winter round must start or open to the public no sooner than April 1st, 2027.
The Spring round of applications opens on February 1st, 2027 at 9:00 GMT.
The Spring round of applications closes on March 1st, 2027 at 23:00 GMT.
Projects funded in the Spring round must start or open to the public no sooner than July 1st, 2027.
The Summer round of applications opens on May 1st, 2027 at 9:00 GMT.
The Summer round of applications closes on June 1st, 2027 at 23:00 GMT.
Projects funded in the Summer round must start or open to the public no sooner than October 1st, 2027.

UK and international non-profit organisations are eligible to apply for exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications and the development of collections.
Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators can apply to the Research and Travel category.
Individuals wishing to create, inform, develop or research their own practice are not eligible.
Residency programmes are not supported.
Central or building costs are not supported.
Traditional memorials/figurative statues are not supported.
Commercial publishing projects are not supported.
Play equipment is not supported.
Community gardens are not supported.
Wellbeing activities are not supported.
Community project applications will only be considered when the applicant is a non-profit arts organisation.
The maximum grant available for New Projects and Commissions is £20,000.
The maximum grant available for Acquisitions and Collections is £20,000.
The maximum grant available for Conferences, Lectures and Publications is £5,000.
The maximum grant available for Long-Term Research grants is £20,000.
The maximum grant available for Research and Travel grants is £2,500.
Applications are submitted via the Flexi-Grant system.
Registration requests must be received one week before the deadline.
